verdict.rationale: The homepage shows an "In collaboration with" Y Combinator badge and startup client logos (Replit, Midjourney), and there is founder-specific O-1 guidance. However, no documented program terms, pricing, or eligibility accompany the badge, so the startup-ecosystem story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: documented terms of the YC collaboration, VC-portfolio arrangements, founder-community or accelerator pricing, eligibility or benefit details, and independent corroboration.
